desc:
• CLASSIC COOKIE MIX: Create chocolate chip cookies for the whole family to enjoy (Do not eat raw cookie dough)

  • QUICK AND EASY: Simply follow the easy steps on the package for warm, home-baked cookies as a chewy, delicious treat any time of the day or night

  • ENDLESS OPTIONS: Prepare cookies as is or explore Betty Crocker recipes for a new take on these classic cookies

  • SPECIAL OCCASION TREATS: Serve chocolate chip cookies for sweet celebrations, food gifts, and everyday occasions; Ideal for goodie bags, birthday parties, and more

  • CONTAINS: One 17.5 oz pouch of Betty Crocker Chocolate Chip Cookie Mix
features:
Features

Classic chocolate chip flavor: Includes real semi-sweet chocolate chips for a rich, indulgent taste.

Easy preparation: Just add butter and an egg—mix, scoop, and bake. No extra ingredients or complicated steps.

Makes a full batch: One 17.5 oz pouch yields approximately 22–24 cookies.

Customizable recipe: Can be enhanced with nuts, candy pieces, coconut, or flavor extracts for your own twist.

Soft and chewy texture: Designed to produce cookies with a satisfying, bakery-style texture.

Trusted baking brand: From Betty Crocker, a well-known name in home baking with decades of reliability. 

Benefits

Quick and convenient: Perfect for last-minute desserts or sudden cookie cravings—ready in minutes.

Family-friendly activity: Easy enough for kids to join in and enjoy the baking process.

Great for gatherings: Ideal for parties, lunchboxes, bake sales, or gifting.

Consistent results: Delivers evenly baked, soft cookies every time with minimal effort.

Economical treat: A budget-friendly way to bake a full batch of cookies without multiple pantry ingredients.
ingredients: Enriched Flour Bleached (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Chocolate Chips (sugar, chocolate liquor, cocoa butter, soy lecithin, natural flavor), Brown Sugar, Sugar, Palm Oil, Leavening (baking soda, sodium aluminum phosphate), Salt, Nonfat Milk.
